topic.title: Specifying a Different CSS File for Each User Role

body.p: You can specify a different custom CSS file for each user role. You can do this in several ways:

ol.li: Create a different framework for each user role. You can use framework extensions or framework extension scripts to avoid duplication between frameworks.

In the same framework, you can create multiple stylesheets that can be switched from the Web Author UI using the More Choose styles action. You can also use the stylesheet-titles URL parameter to specify a comma-separated list of the stylesheet titles to use.
You can use the AuthorPreloadProcessor API to set a pseudo-class on the root element based on the user role, and then use it in CSS selectors to adjust the appearance for that role.
